headline: Religare Finvest’s replay shows a funding warning before default—and why it was not enough
dek: A watch-band funding signal preceded Religare Finvest’s default in a historical replay. Fraud masking and proxy timing make the case an investigative prompt, not a validated forecast.

review_notes: Removed causal detail and investability implications not supported by the dossier.
Separated filing-proxy evidence from market-price authority and model diagnostics.
Preserved fraud masking, missing-liability, stale-data, and construction-PIT disclosures.
